scope: Keep explicitly authored root responsive display and min-height styles effective on mobile public pages, matching the static template and Editor Canvas.

finding.source: The static visual-page template excludes .visual-root-authored from its mobile canvas display/min-height fallback, but the dynamically injected renderer fallback targeted all visual-editor-canvas roots and overrode authored styles with display:block!important and min-height:0!important.
finding.resolution: Aligned the injected selector with the static template by excluding .visual-root-authored. This keeps legacy/template mobile stacking while allowing authored root display and min-height from resolved responsive Page Model values.
